title: Dental Emergency & Trauma
description: Stomatologiya bo'yicha Shoshilinch stomatologik jarohat mavzusida klinik muloqot va tibbiy ingliz tili darsi.
scenario_prompt: You are a virtual patient presenting with symptoms related to Dental Emergency & Trauma. Speak in natural, everyday patient English.

patient_profile.history: Patient presents with complaints of dental emergency & trauma.

grammar.title: Clinical Grammar Focus
grammar.rule_explanation: Klinik muloqotda aniq grammatik qoidalar bemor holatini to'g'ri baholashga yordam beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Klinik muloqotda aniq grammatik qoidalar bemor holatini to'g'ri baholashga yordam beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В клиническом диалоге точные грамматические структуры помогают быстрее понять жалобы пациента.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Using precise clinical grammatical structures enables clear patient history taking and assessment.
grammar.structure_pattern: Did + Subject + Base Verb? | Subject + V2 (Past Simple)

examples.sentence: How long has this symptom been bothering you?
examples.translation: Bu simptom sizni qancha vaqtdan beri bezovta qilmoqda?
examples.translation_uz: Bu simptom sizni qancha vaqtdan beri bezovta qilmoqda?
examples.translation_ru: Как долго вас беспокоит этот симптом?

examples.sentence: Does the pain get worse with hot or cold temperatures?
examples.translation: Og'riq issiq yoki sovuq haroratda kuchayadimi?
examples.translation_uz: Og'riq issiq yoki sovuq haroratda kuchayadimi?
examples.translation_ru: Усиливается ли боль от горячего или холодного?

common_mistakes.incorrect: Since when you feel this pain?
common_mistakes.correct: How long have you had this pain?
common_mistakes.explanation: Davomiylikni so'rashda 'How long have you had...?' standarti ishlatiladi.
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: Davomiylikni so'rashda 'How long have you had...?' standarti ishlatiladi.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: Для выяснения длительности используется конструкция 'How long have you had...?'.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Use 'How long have you had...?' when asking about the duration of symptoms.

common_mistakes.correct: Where exactly do you feel the pain?
common_mistakes.explanation: Lokatsiyani aniqlashda 'Where do you feel the pain?' to'g'ri grammatik shakl.
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: Lokatsiyani aniqlashda 'Where do you feel the pain?' to'g'ri grammatik shakl.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: Правильный вопрос о локализации боли: 'Where exactly do you feel the pain?'.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Ask 'Where exactly do you feel the pain?' to identify the specific anatomical site.

phrasebook.phrase: What seems to be the problem?
phrasebook.patient_response: I've been suffering from an intense ache... The throbbing HAD BEEN GETTING worse all day, and it became agonizing last night.

phrasebook.phrase: HAD YOU BEEN EXPERIENCING any discomfort before the pain reached that level?
phrasebook.hint: Og'riq ushbu darajaga yetguncha ham biror noqulaylik sezganmidingiz?
phrasebook.hint_uz: Og'riq ushbu darajaga yetguncha ham biror noqulaylik sezganmidingiz?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. I HAD BEEN FEELING a dull ache for about three days, but I HAD IGNORED it.

phrasebook.phrase: HAD YOU NOTICED any swelling or sensitivity prior to last night?
phrasebook.hint_ru: Есть ли припухлость или гнойные выделения?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes, the gum HAD SWOLLEN slightly. I HAD ALSO NOTICED that the tooth was sensitive to cold drinks.

phrasebook.phrase: HAD YOU TAKEN any painkillers before coming to the clinic?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. I HAD SWALLOWED two tablets, but they HAD BARELY DULLENED the pain.

phrasebook.phrase: HAD YOU BEEN CHEWING hard food or HAD YOU INJURED the tooth?
phrasebook.hint: Qattiq yegulik chaynaganmidingiz yoki tishni shikastlaganmidingiz?
phrasebook.hint_uz: Qattiq yegulik chaynaganmidingiz yoki tishni shikastlaganmidingiz?
phrasebook.patient_response: I HADN'T INJURED it, but I HAD BEEN CHEWING mostly on that side because the other HAD BEEN BOTHERING me.

phrasebook.phrase: It looks as though the infection HAD BEEN SPREADING under the surface and reached the root.
phrasebook.hint: Og'riq boshqa joyga (quloq, jag', bo'yin) tarqaladimi?
phrasebook.hint_uz: Og'riq boshqa joyga (quloq, jag', bo'yin) tarqaladimi?
phrasebook.hint_ru: Отдает (иррадиирует) ли боль в челюсть, ухо или шею?
phrasebook.patient_response: Is it serious? I'm worried you'll have to extract it.

phrasebook.phrase: HAD THE TOOTH RECEIVED any treatment in the past?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. A dentist HAD PLACED a filling there several years ago.

phrasebook.phrase: The old filling HAD DETERIORATED, and bacteria HAD BEEN ENTERING over time.
phrasebook.hint: Eski plomba yemirilgan va vaqt o'tishi bilan bakteriyalar kirib borgan.
phrasebook.hint_uz: Eski plomba yemirilgan va vaqt o'tishi bilan bakteriyalar kirib borgan.
phrasebook.patient_response: So what is the next step?

phrasebook.phrase: I'll use a local anesthetic to numb the area. You shouldn't feel sharp pain.
phrasebook.hint: Joyni uyushtirish uchun mahalliy anesteziya qilaman. Keskin og'riq bo'lmaydi.
phrasebook.hint_uz: Joyni uyushtirish uchun mahalliy anesteziya qilaman. Keskin og'riq bo'lmaydi.
phrasebook.patient_response: That's a relief! I HAD BEEN STRESSING about the procedure all morning.

phrasebook.phrase: If you HAD COME when the discomfort first started, we could have treated it faster.
phrasebook.hint: Diskomfort boshlangan paytda kelganingizda, ancha tezroq davolagan bo'lardik.
phrasebook.hint_uz: Diskomfort boshlangan paytda kelganingizda, ancha tezroq davolagan bo'lardik.
phrasebook.patient_response: I understand. If I HAD COME earlier, would the treatment have been simpler?

tests.question: What is the medical meaning of the term 'bottom back teeth' in clinical consultation?
tests.explanation: 'bottom back teeth' atamasining to'g'ri ma'nosi: pastki orqa tishlar.

tests.question: Which term corresponds to 'yo'qolmoq, bosilmoq'?
tests.explanation: 'yo'qolmoq, bosilmoq' ma'nosiga mos keluvchi tibbiy termin 'fade away' hisoblanadi.

tests.question: Which of the following is the grammatically and clinically standard question to ask about the duration of symptoms?
tests.option_a: How long do you having this symptom?
tests.option_b: How long has this condition been bothering you?
tests.option_c: Since what time you have this problem?
tests.option_d: How many days you are feeling pain?
tests.explanation: Klinik anamnezda davomiylikni so'rash uchun Present Perfect Continuous ('How long has... been bothering you?') to'g'ri shakl hisoblanadi.

tests.question: When evaluating acute pain, what is the best phrasing to assess pain character?
tests.option_a: Is your pain bad or very bad?
tests.option_b: Can you describe the pain—is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
tests.option_c: Why do you have sharp pain today?
tests.explanation: Og'riq xarakterini aniqlashda shifokor ochiq va taklif qiluvchi variantlar (sharp, dull, throbbing, aching) beradi.
